message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts. The case: a construction contractor without qualification, failed to ensure safety, leading to death of worker due to fall from height. This is a production safety accident causing death. In Chinese criminal law, this is "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) or "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) or "以危险方法危害公共安全" etc. The list includes "重大责任事故" and "过失致人死亡". Also "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". Which fits? The facts: violation of safety regulations, failure to provide safety measures, leading to death. This is typical of "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) which is a specific crime under Chinese law (Article 133). The examples earlier: first two examples with mining accident and forklift accident were labeled "重大责任事故". Those were also safety accidents causing death. So we should label "重大责任事故". No other crimes like "非法占用农用地" etc. So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>.

Check list: "重大责任事故" is present. So final answer.
